name: W Philadelphia
positioning: A W hotel in Center City Philadelphia, just south of City Hall, with a seventh-floor rooftop pool deck and design that weaves in the city's history
best_for: Couples and culture lovers who want a stylish Center City base near the Avenue of the Arts
Travelers who want a year-round heated rooftop pool and a spa in the city

facts.text: The hotel is just south of City Hall in Center City, with easy access to the business district.
Reading Terminal Market is a short walk away.
The Avenue of the Arts, with its theaters and music venues, stretches just south of the hotel.
Rooms have floor-to-ceiling views of the city.
Some rooms have mural-like headboards showing Philly neighborhoods or light fixtures inspired by Benjamin Franklin's lightning rod experiments.
Many suites have soaking tubs or private balconies.
At AWAY Spa, treatments start with a signature ginger shot, and the menu includes detox facials and a Balance CBD massage.
CONTRAST, a sauna and cold-plunge experience, is available as an add-on to a stay.
WET Deck access is included with facial, body and massage treatments on weekdays.
Stevens' Prophecy is an intimate salon-style space hidden behind a two-way mirror in the Living Room bar.
Concierge staff can help with hard-to-get restaurant reservations and private tours at the Philadelphia Museum of Art.

highlights.text: The seventh-floor rooftop terrace has the WET Deck pool, cabanas and a fire pit, with views of City Hall.
The outdoor heated pool is open year-round.
The Penthouse Suite has river-to-river views from a private balcony and an in-room DJ booth.
The lobby floor tiles are a gridded map art installation reproducing a 19th-century guidebook, a nod to the city's historic grid.
The Philly toile bed linens show a muscular Ben Franklin designed by a local art school graduate.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
Parking at the hotel is by valet.
WhataHotel notes the urban setting comes with typical city noise.
